reason: Adds an Auto model route that classifies each turn and dispatches it to a configured fast or slow DeepSeek model, with documented fallback and configuration options.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加自动模型选项，通过分类每轮请求并将其路由到配置的快速或高性能模型。
summaries.en: Adds an Auto model option to DeepSeek Harness that classifies each turn and routes it to a configured fast or high-capability model.
